The bristles are coarser than other Badger hair brushes that I have tried.  Makes you wonder if it is really a Badger brush. 3. It has a heavy handle, but I don't see that as a particular advantage. 4. It looks decent. 5. I am unconvinced about its 'value for money'.

reviews.t: Not quite my grandfather's shaving brush
reviews.x: My maternal grandfather passed away some 40 years ago. After my mother returned from her out-of-state trip to be with her mother and bury her father, she gave me a small box containing some of his personal belongings. Among them was his Ever Ready PBT300 shaving brush. I had no use for it at the time. As I unpacked after a recent move I rediscovered this item and decided to use it. It was really enjoyable, so after a few months I decided granddad's brush should be properly retired and I should g

I was looking for a badger shaving brush since the boar brush I have had became completely unusable after just 2 years of use. It was losing hairs almost every day. Need to note that was a cheap one which came in a set with a soap and a bowl for $12 altogether. After eliminating expensive badger brushes from my search I narrowed the options to this one, Colonel Conk's brush and Kingsley's each costs around 22-25$. This was an impulse purchase. I thought it looked good, and I'd get a little use out of it. But it was bought mostly on looks alone.  Boy, was I pleasantly surprised. This is a beautiful, full badger brush that simply out performs my much more expensive bush (which has been relegated to my gym bag).  It is rare when an impulse purchase exceeds expectations. So if you're a beginning Mekur double-edge wet shaver like me, this is very much worth the investment. I don't know how much better brushes

Given that I was charged the lower price of the Tweezerman, I have no complaints.  I knew that something was odd when I opened the package and found a brush with a chrome instead of wooden handle. Honestly, I gave it no thought at the time and started using the brush the same day it arrived.  Now I can't say that I've been using a shaving brush long enough

A sign that the chrome is very thin, thinly chromed accessories discolor from heat. Its not like I'm using super hot water, just what is coming out of the faucet. Oh well. I like the heavy feel of the handle but wonder if it's really necessary. The hairs are started to come out now at a steady rate. I'll probably start looking for something

Little surprised on the quality of this brush. The chrome has some imperfections, but that I will not fault. This brush is fairly heavy. The bristles are surprising soft. I'm going to go out on limb here and say this is the best $15 badger brush available. Get one!

This is a really nice brush, well made, and a solid value for the money (I got it when it was at 19.95). It looks quite nice, and performs as well as it looks. The chrome handle is a chromed metal rather than plastic, so it is heavy, and holds heat well. I pre-heat the brush along with my mug and soap before I make lather, and really like the way the heated brush handle feels in my hand while I'm making the lather. reviews.t: Nice and heavy, feels well made
reviews.x: This is a very nice brush. Very heavy with the all metal handle. In 2 weeks of use i have only seen one bristle come out. It does indeed smell like a wet badger, but all the nice brushes smell this way.  The packaging on this is less than you'd expect. Basically the brush in a clear box. Not really a glamorous gift to open. So re-box if you want to give someone a nice gift. I bought for my self so I didn't care, just shocked how poor the boxing was compared to the item itself.

Been using for about a month now. Bristles are softer than I had read they might be.  Chrome handle is very solid and a bit heavy but really not a problem.  I thought the smooth chrome might be slippery to handle while brushing on the soap but hasn't been.  The handle at its narrowest point nearest the foot is for what ever reason just slightly oblong and as a result will slide into the brush holder I purchased with it [[ASIN:B001XURHNY Colonel Conk Evernice Model 775 Chrome Safety Razor Stand]]

There are some websites with reviews on too many brushes. I didn't find any review on this one at those websites. I was afraid that I might get a lousy one. I'm glad this is not the case. Whew! It has good brush. It holds brush well and doesn't lose any hair when I forcibly push it into a tight brush holder. It looks nice. The reason I bought it is its chrome. It matched my bathroom's style. As I've learned from reviews, badger brush is better than synthetic or boar brush. By the way, it is my f

reviews.t: You get what you pay for
reviews.x: I bought one a year ago and it was a terrific purchase. So I purchased 3 as gifts. They were cheaply made. Compared to the original brush I purchased in 2012. The new one.... The handle is much lighter. The Bristles are more sparse. The bristles are very thin. The bristles come out of the handle. All in all

For $25 this is a wonderful shaving brush for those of us who prefer to really coat our beards in pure soap ,rather than chemicals and menthol, before we shave. This brush looks classy, has great heft in your hand and does a wonderul job.
I had one years ago and it lasted and lasted.  I bought several replacement ones that would last only a year or so before falling apart.  Cheap oneslost bristles daily--thus one has yet to lose any.
WOW!!! What an OUTSTANDING brush!!!!  You feel the heft, which makes it great, after a few uses, it starts filling out and spreads foam great.  Would highly recommend this to family and friends.
Don't waste your time here.  If you want to get into wet shaving you might as well spend the extra $20 on a decent brush.  I bought this and within a month the brush fell out of the handle.
This is my first ever badger brush.  It produces a nice lather and was a reasonable price.  I have nothing to compare it to, but I am more than satisfied with this product.
For the price, you just can't beat this brush. Super soft bristles, full plume, and makes a really nice lather. Well-done!
The head of the brush was cheaply glued to the chrome handle and fell off after 2 weeks moderate use.

Are you sometimes grumpy or blue when you get out of bed? Well, now that I have a good brush and a good soap, every morning holds the promise of a nice shave. I feel sorry for the ladies, I don't think shaving your legs once a week gives you the same comfort. Forget penis envy :).....Will the brush last for years? Only time will tell, but given that even mass produced ones can last for years, I'm guessing this one could be something you can put in your will. I've only had it for a few months, bu

Right out of the gate you know you have a great brush. The bristles are quite stiff and generate a fine later quickly with very little soap. The bristles hold up under the hottest water never and "go limp".  The handle is flawless chrome plated metal. Not certain, but its heavy, like brass or steel. By heavy I mean that if you drop it on your toe, it will break your toe. I'm kind of afraid that it will break my shaving mug if I'm not careful.  I took away one star because it is quite slick when

The brush looks great. It will make any bathroom setup look classy. However, after using the brush twice, the hair part of the brush detached from the chrome handle. This looked like it was due to a poor glue job. I exchanged it from amazon for a second one. Same thing happened. Buyer's beware, I believe this is a manufacturer defect since it happened twice. It is an easy job to super glue them together. So overall, I am content with the brush.  Pros: Looks great Cons: Cheap glue that holds hair

When I got this the bristle "cone" was separated from the metal base. I had to glue it back together. If they had flared the "cup" for the bristles out a bit at the bottom it would have stayed in there. Wasn't worth shipping back since it took me 5 minutes to fix but the quality is apparently not that good.  Decent comfort. I like the handle.
The handle on this brush is outstanding.  Good weight, comfortable to hold and good looking.  The badger on this could be a bit softer, but a good value none the less.  I would recommend.
I've been using a mug and brush for many years.  Without a doubt, this is the best brush I've evr owned.  Its priced really great, delivers a great lather, and has a good weight to it.

claims.text: Many reviewers consider the brush a great value for the money, praising its performance relative to its low price.
Reviewers frequently describe the handle as heavy and solid-feeling, which most see as a positive.
Several reviewers report bristles shedding or falling out, with some noting quality declined compared to earlier versions.
Opinions on bristle softness vary, with some finding them surprisingly soft and others finding them coarse or sparse.
A few reviewers mention chrome handle imperfections or discoloration over time.
